subject: Social Media
title: Accountability vs. Mob Justice
description: A short lesson to help you apply Accountability vs. Mob Justice.

hook.text: Weinstein was investigated, tried, and convicted. That's accountability. Most online takedowns skip every step.

buildup.text: Accountability needs evidence, due process, and proportional consequences. Mob justice needs a screenshot.

discovery.text: #MeToo used social media to expose real crimes. It also spawned accusations without evidence or trial.

twist.text: The line between accountability and mob justice is context. Online, context is the first casualty.

climax.text: The question isn't whether accountability matters. It's whether mob tools can deliver justice. Usually not.

punchline.text: Justice has steps. Mobs skip them all.

quiz.question: What distinguishes accountability from mob justice?
